text: Equilibrium-trajectory separation cannot be evaluated until a common stochastic process, its filtrations, a concentration functional, and a cross-mode estimand are defined.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: It cannot be evaluated until a common stochastic process for Mode A and Mode B, its ﬁltrations, a concentration functional, and a cross-mode estimand are deﬁned. Finding 7 reports two stability statistics from the sweep. Those statistics do not deﬁne or test the proposed separation.

value: the proposed separation of Mode A and Mode B trajectories
